$comment: Contract for the SetFailAccountability server-side command (AD-003, AD-039, OD-024). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_SetFailAccountability). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_SetFailAccountability
customApi.description: Records who is accountable for a File Quality or Advice Quality fail on an Outcome (OD-024), the judgement AD-039's export columns 11-14 and 17-20 report. Refuses a pass Outcome or a case with no outcome recorded. Enforces the page.cases Edit permission and writes an immutable Audit Event (BR-012).

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_outcome record to record accountability against.

requestParameters.name: FqAdviser
requestParameters.description: True when the adviser is accountable for the File Quality fail.

requestParameters.name: FqParaplanner
requestParameters.description: True when the paraplanner is accountable for the File Quality fail.

requestParameters.name: AqAdviser
requestParameters.description: True when the adviser is accountable for the Advice Quality fail.

requestParameters.name: AqParaplanner
requestParameters.description: True when the paraplanner is accountable for the Advice Quality fail.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.
